name: cli-web-ui-flag
description: Verify --web-ui is registered, launches the engine + webui, serves both over HTTP, and cleans up both child processes on real Ctrl+C and SIGTERM with no orphans. Signals are delivered inside the tmux pane's own shell (a real PTY/foreground process group for Ctrl+C, pattern-based pkill for SIGTERM) rather than by PID from outside, since that is how these signals actually reach a running kollab process.

steps.title: --web-ui serves engine + webui and shuts down cleanly on real Ctrl+C

steps.command: pkill -f 'main.py --web-ui' 2>/dev/null; pkill -f 'kollabor_engine serve' 2>/dev/null; pkill -f 'from kollabor_webui import main' 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; echo READY_FOR_TEST
steps.description: Ensure no leftover engine/webui from a prior run

steps.command: for i in $(seq 1 40); do curl -fs http://127.0.0.1:7433/health >/dev/null 2>&1 && curl -fs http://127.0.0.1:18092/ >/dev/null 2>&1 && { echo WEBUI_SIGINT_HEALTH_OK; exit 0; }; sleep 0.5; done; echo WEBUI_SIGINT_HEALTH_FAIL
steps.description: Poll engine /health and webui / until both respond
engine /health and webui / both respond 200 while running

steps.command: for i in $(seq 1 20); do pgrep -f 'main.py --web-ui' >/dev/null 2>&1 || break; sleep 0.3; done; sleep 1; if lsof -iTCP:7433 -sTCP:LISTEN -n -P >/dev/null 2>&1 || lsof -iTCP:18092 -sTCP:LISTEN -n -P >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo WEBUI_SIGINT_CLEANUP_FAIL; else echo WEBUI_SIGINT_CLEANUP_OK; fi; if pgrep -f 'kollabor_engine serve|from kollabor_webui import main' >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo WEBUI_SIGINT_ORPHAN_FAIL; else echo WEBUI_SIGINT_ORPHAN_OK; fi
steps.description: After Ctrl+C: verify both ports released and no orphaned children
both ports are released after Ctrl+C
no orphaned engine/webui processes remain after Ctrl+C

steps.title: --web-ui shuts down cleanly on SIGTERM (e.g. a process manager stopping it)

steps.command: for i in $(seq 1 40); do curl -fs http://127.0.0.1:7433/health >/dev/null 2>&1 && curl -fs http://127.0.0.1:18093/ >/dev/null 2>&1 && { echo WEBUI_SIGTERM_HEALTH_OK; exit 0; }; sleep 0.5; done; echo WEBUI_SIGTERM_HEALTH_FAIL
steps.description: Poll engine /health and webui / until both respond
engine /health and webui / both respond 200 while running (second instance)

steps.command: pkill -TERM -f 'main.py --web-ui'; for i in $(seq 1 20); do pgrep -f 'main.py --web-ui' >/dev/null 2>&1 || break; sleep 0.3; done; sleep 1; if lsof -iTCP:7433 -sTCP:LISTEN -n -P >/dev/null 2>&1 || lsof -iTCP:18093 -sTCP:LISTEN -n -P >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo WEBUI_SIGTERM_CLEANUP_FAIL; else echo WEBUI_SIGTERM_CLEANUP_OK; fi; if pgrep -f 'kollabor_engine serve|from kollabor_webui import main' >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo WEBUI_SIGTERM_ORPHAN_FAIL; else echo WEBUI_SIGTERM_ORPHAN_OK; fi
steps.description: pkill -TERM the launcher (pattern-based, not a bare PID), verify cleanup
both ports are released after SIGTERM
no orphaned engine/webui processes remain after SIGTERM
